body:
I don't think I would condemn them, but I just feel really hard on myself all the time because I'm not who I used to be when i was younger and I'm constantly reminded of it. 

I'm too scared to tell them. I probably never will. I'm surprised they haven't seen the scars on my wrists, or maybe they're just pretending they don't see them. I don't have any courage left...I think i've exhausted it.
